rule: A model joins the mill rotation's newest classes only with (a) a release date from a primary source inside its class window: newest-30d = the last 30 days; recent-60d = the last 60 days, for models released after the fleet was frozen that the 30-day window already missed; (b) an open licence that allows evaluation and needs no gated click-through (the kernel holds no HF token); (c) a runtime Ollama can load: EITHER a GGUF whose general.architecture is in upstream llama.cpp (src/llama-arch.cpp) and whose manifest carries a chat template, OR an Ollama-library manifest whose config blob names a built-in renderer and a `requires` version <= the Ollama the kernel last ran (environment.json ollama_server_version); a manifest with neither a template nor a renderer is NOT eligible; (d) weights plus projector that fit Kaggle's 2x T4: <= ~10 GB on one T4 with KV-cache headroom, or <= 24 GB split over both (Ollama spreads layers across GPUs when one card is too small; the worker sets no num_gpu; 2 x 15,360 MiB leaves >= ~6 GB for KV cache and CUDA contexts); and (e) a manifest digest pinned HERE before the kernel runs. The kernel halts if the pulled manifest differs from the pin. Our own models are never eligible. Priority orders the first measurement only: an unmeasured model goes first, and after its first OK slice it joins the daily rotation (run.sh).
pin_method: sha256 of the manifest bytes served by the Ollama registry protocol (GET https://huggingface.co/v2/<ns>/<repo>/manifests/<quant>, Accept application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json). Validated 2026-09-28: the same method applied to registry.ollama.ai/v2/library/qwen2.5/manifests/7b reproduces the 3090 pin 845dbda0... exactly. Fetched twice per model; both fetches identical. Re-validated 2026-09-28T14:0xZ by lane newest-models-20260928 from the build pod: qwen2.5:7b -> 845dbda0... again, and both existing pins (dbdd4bb7..., c7e50c7f...) reproduced byte-for-byte; every new pin below fetched twice, identical.
